svg.title: Clonality (FACETS) — Colorectal, Breast
svg.text: 5,379 of 5,395 samples have FACETS estimates; 4,912 pass QC
6,703 of 6,907 samples have FACETS estimates; 6,204 pass QC
FACETS allele-specific copy number: each OncoKB driver (v7.5) mutation call — one mutation in one sample — is clonal, subclonal or indeterminate as FACETS called it
from its cancer-cell fraction; uncalled calls have an estimate but no call. LOH at the locus is a minor copy number of 0 where one was estimated. Only samples whose
FACETS_QC is Pass are used (Colorectal: 4,912 pass, 451 fail; Breast: 6,204 pass, 671 fail); qc: false uses every sample. Whole-genome doubling, purity and ploidy are
FACETS's own per-sample calls. Clonality is only as good as the purity estimate behind it: a low-purity sample's clonal mutation can be called subclonal, and a panel's
handful of mutations per sample makes each estimate coarse. Two cohorts: Fisher on clonal against subclonal calls per gene (BH across genes) and on WGD.
